limitations: Use only trusted credential-free development pages; recordings are not automatically redacted.
Fresh browser context, no user profile, credentials or authenticated sessions are imported.
Only configured loopback origins can load resources; third-party network requests are blocked.
Frame-step, height, opacity and containment are supplied contracts, not universal motion-quality scores.
Mutations are timestamped at MutationObserver delivery; recording seeks use approximate host offsets.

WAAPI cancel/start batches include supplemental before/after geometry reads after microtasks. They are not painted-frame evidence and do not increase rAF sample counts. Geometry reads may force style/layout work. CSS-only changes and old captures do not gain these boundaries.

Post-rAF tasks use MessageChannel. Geometry reads and recorder work can perturb the runner; observedAtMs, probe cost and actual gaps are reported. Visible means nonzero rendered geometry and computed visibility/opacity, not proof of unoccluded pixels.
CSS cancellation events and Web Animations calls are observed where available; arbitrary animation-library internals are not inferred.
Source mappings and application marks are explicitly supplied annotations.
